mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a strengthening economy and potential for higher interest rates, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate growth-driven earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals an economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a slowing economy under monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth concerns dominate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) signals overheating and potential for a recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in a slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
